name: Studio SL
description: Studio SL is a boutique beauty salon by Stephanie, offering refined cuts, rich dimensional color, and effortless styling in a calm, modern space.

hero.title: Effortless beauty, thoughtfully crafted.
hero.subtitle: Refined cuts, rich color, and polished styling from Stephanie at Studio SL — book your appointment today.

stylists.name: Stephanie
stylists.title: Owner & Lead Stylist
stylists.bio: Stephanie founded Studio SL to create a calm, elevated space where every client is truly listened to. She loves rich, dimensional color — especially warm coppers and reds — and polished, effortless styles that fit real life.

reviews.name: Lauren K.
reviews.text: Stephanie nailed my copper color — it's exactly the shade I've been chasing for years. The studio is gorgeous and so relaxing.

reviews.name: Amanda P.
reviews.text: Best haircut I've had in a long time. She really listens and gives honest advice about what will work for your hair.

reviews.name: Rachel D.
reviews.text: Stephanie did my bridal hair and it held beautifully all night. I felt so taken care of from start to finish.

reviews.name: Megan S.
reviews.text: Clean, calm, and beautifully designed salon. My blowout lasted almost a week. Highly recommend Studio SL!
